review: Inspected session tool calls: only assigned execution plan, full bounded reader, pinned checker, maintained handoff, and in-memory authoring/revision were used. Initially truncated source lines were reread and authenticated before authoring. No reviewer identities, scores, external files, network or paid services were accessed. Unsaved transport diagnostics and local socket permission recovery produced no extra saved submission. The same context replaced one preserved unsaved candidate after source-definition review; output was saved exactly once.
